tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find a restaurant to order food from (delivery or pickup) or to eat at, and the restaurant could be on Bite2u "Order here" (bite2u.com/order). Searches by restaurant name, city, cuisine or dish. Returns only restaurants listed on Bite2u, with whether they are open now

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see the menu, dishes or prices of a restaurant returned by search_restaurants. Pass that restaurant's slug. Returns the menu by category with prices in the restaurant's currency, availability and allergens, plus order_url: the user completes the order and payment on t

tools.name: prepare_order
tools.description: Use this when the user has chosen dishes from a menu returned by get_menu and wants to order. Pass the restaurant slug and the items (dish_id from get_menu, quantity, and size_id / options when the dish has sizes or option groups). It checks every item against the current menu and returns the lines,
